faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to your questions regarding metal doors and motors
faq.q1: How long does it take to install a sectional door?
faq.a1: Complete installation usually takes between 4 and 8 hours depending on dimensions.
faq.q2: Do you offer emergency service outside business hours?
faq.a2: Yes, we provide 24/7 emergency service 365 days a year for urgent breakdowns.
faq.q3: What warranty is included with the motors and systems?
faq.a3: All new motors include a 2-year manufacturer warranty plus our professional installation warranty.
faq.q4: Can an existing manual door be automated without replacing it?
faq.a4: Yes, in most cases we can install certified motors (Somfy, CAME, Erreka, FAAC) onto your existing door without costly remodeling.
faq.q5: Is there any cost for the technical visit or quote?
faq.a5: The quote is 100% free with no obligation. It includes on-site technical consultation, precise measurements, and a detailed material breakdown.
faq.q6: Do you supply and program remote controls and safety photocells?
faq.a6: Yes, we program high-security rolling-code remotes and install anti-crush safety photocells compliant with European safety regulations.
